message.content:
The `isea_triangle_xy` uses `(triangle - 1) % 20` which bounds it. The `isea_ptdd` uses `(tri - 1) % 5` and `(tri - 1) / 10` which are bounded. The `az_adjustment` at line 252 uses `vertex[tri_v1[triangle]]` and `icostriangles[triangle]` directly without bounds check, but it's called with `i` from 1 to 20 in setup.

The issue says "array lookup with wrong indices due to missing validation before accessing the array". Let me look at `isea_transform` which computes `tri` from input coordinates - this is where an out-of-bounds triangle index could come from. Let me look at `isea_transform` at line 645.
